# sevenx_multisite and cjw_multisite compared

Exponential 6.0.15 offers two multisite packages: **sevenx_multisite**, the default, and **cjw_multisite**, the CJW
starter site. The CJW installer was generated from the 7x one, so they share most of their code, but they differ in
where their design, content, images and layouts come from. This page puts them side by side, for administrators and
hosts choosing one, and for developers deciding which one to start from for a package of their own.

All facts come from the two source repositories,
[se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage) (`packages/sevenx_multisite`,
`packages/sevenx_multisite_democontent`) and
[se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage), and from the 6.0.15
[index.xml](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/index.xml).

## At a glance

| | sevenx_multisite | cjw_multisite |
|---|---|---|
| Index summary | 7x MultiSite Default Installation | CJW Multisite |
| Index version | `6.0-15-stable` (`1.0.0-0` until 2026-10-19) | `6.0-15-stable` (`6.0.15-0` until 2026-10-19) |
| Default package of `exp:install` and the kickstarter examples | yes | no |
| Design of the public site | `media` (then `ezwebin`, `standard`, `base`) | `starter` (then `standard`) |
| Theme extension of the public site | `sevenx_themes_media` (with `sevenx_themes_simple`) | `cjw_themes_jumper` (both 7x theme extensions stay in `ActiveExtensions[]`) |
| Sites | Fit & Healthy, plus Bold Agency (`bold`, `bold_ger`) when the theme provides them | the starter site only |
| Default site title | Fit & Healthy (Bold Agency on a `bold` siteaccess) | CJW JAC Exponential |
| Variant without demo content | `sevenx_multisite_clean` | none |

## Packages and sizes

| | sevenx_multisite | cjw_multisite |
|---|---|---|
| Required packages | `sevenx_classes`, `sevenx_multisite_democontent` | `sevenx_classes`, `cjw_multisite_democontent` |
| Site package archive | 90,369 bytes | 97,634 bytes |
| Content package archive | 62,314,497 bytes | 169,949 bytes |
| Class definitions in the content package | 62 | 40 |
| Object files in the content package | 404 | 138 |
| Simple-file entries | 314, carried in the package's `simplefiles/` (194 files) | 158, pointing into `extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share/` |
| Side files read by the installer | none | `cjw-class-additions.xml`, `cjw-explayouts.json`, `cjw-paths.json`, `cjw-starter-import.json` |

Archive sizes are the `content-length` of the 6.0.15 files on the package server. The large difference is the
images: `sevenx_multisite_democontent` carries its own, while `cjw_multisite_democontent` reads them from the theme
extension during the install (see [The demo content package](the-demo-content-package.md)).

## Design, content and data

| | sevenx_multisite | cjw_multisite |
|---|---|---|
| Home page remote id | `media-n-939` (Fit & Healthy) | `cjw-starter-n-779` (Startseite) |
| Object files | named by 32-character remote id (`object-<remote id>.xml`) | `object-cjw-starter-o-<id>.xml`; nodes `cjw-starter-n-<id>`, tags `cjw-starter-t-<id>` |
| Content languages | see [The demo content packages](../sevenx-multisite/the-demo-content-packages.md) | mostly `ger-DE` (111 of 137 objects only German) |
| Layout rows | from `extension/sevenx_themes_media/share/db_data.dba` and `extension/explayouts/share/db_data.dba` (`declaredExtensionSchemas()` loads data for both) | from `cjw-explayouts.json` in the content package, ids from 900000 (`cjwSeedStarterLayouts()`); no extension `db_data.dba` is loaded |
| Tags | eztags rows in the `db_data.dba` of `sevenx_themes_media` and `explayouts` | made from `cjw-starter-import.json` below a tag "Starter" |
| Star ratings | rekeyed after the install (`postInstallRekeyStarRatings`) | none |
| Extension settings for the site | the theme's settings for a siteaccess named `site`; translations take them with `ExtensionSettingsSiteAccess=<user siteaccess>` | `ExtensionSettingsSiteAccess=cjw_starter` |
| RSS feed source | below the Fit & Healthy home | below the starter root |
| Extra role policy | none | `osm_proxy/tiles` for the starter's maps |

The details of the 7x side are on [Layouts data and share .dba files](../sevenx-multisite/layouts-data-and-share-dba.md).

## Siteaccesses and languages

| | sevenx_multisite | cjw_multisite |
|---|---|---|
| User siteaccess | `site` by default | `site` by default |
| Translation siteaccesses | one per further language | one per further language (`ger` for `ger-DE`) |
| Secondary siteaccesses | `bold`, `bold_ger` when available | none |
| Administration | `admin` (`admin4l`), `editor`, `adminui` | the same |
| Language advice | see [Siteaccesses and languages of sevenx_multisite](../sevenx-multisite/siteaccesses-and-languages.md) | choose `ger-DE` too: `--languages=eng-US,ger-DE` (package description) |

## The installers

| | sevenx_multisite | cjw_multisite |
|---|---|---|
| Class | `sevenxMultiSiteInstaller` | `cjwMultiSiteInstaller` |
| Main file | `sevenx-multi-site-installer.php`, 7,692 lines | `cjw-multi-site-installer.php`, 5,939 lines |
| Helper files | `post-install-fix.php`, 1,050 lines | `post-install-fix.php`, 593 lines (functions renamed `sevenx*` to `cjw*`), `cjw-starter-install.php`, 827 lines |
| `solutionExtensionName()` | `sevenx_multisite_default_installer` | `cjw_multisite_default_installer` |
| `ActiveExtensions[]` | the 7x list | the same list plus `cjw_themes_jumper` and `cjw_tmv` (left out when `extension/cjw_tmv` is missing) |
| Steps only here | `postInstallRekeyStarRatings`, `postInstallCleanUrlText` | `postInstallStarterContent`, `postInstallStarterPaths`, `postInstallStarterPolicyPages` |
| Shared steps | language and name repairs, admin and user siteaccess settings, translations, roles, admin layouts, URL aliases, home and prefix, `ezinfo` closed on public siteaccesses, adminui, search statistics, `ezurlmultisite` | the same |

Both settings lists in `package.xml` are identical in shape: `ini-site.php`, `ini-admin.php`, `ini-common.php`, the
installer, `install-scripts.php`, `roles.php`, `preferences.php`.

| Source repository | sevenx-ezpackage | cjw_multisite-ezpackage |
|---|---|---|
| History | 1,226 commits, the first on 2006-10-12 | 16 commits, the first on 2026-10-07 |
| Packages | all 7x packages (`packages/<name>/`, `packages/build.sh`) | the two CJW packages (`bin/pack.sh`) |

## Which one to choose

| You want | Choose |
|---|---|
| The default demo of Exponential with several sites, English content and the media design | `sevenx_multisite` |
| The same without demo content | `sevenx_multisite_clean` |
| A German and English starter site with the CJW Themes Jumper look | `cjw_multisite` |
| A model for a package built around **your own theme extension**, with images kept in the extension | start from `cjw_multisite` |
| A model for a package with several sites and its data in extension `.dba` files | start from `sevenx_multisite` |

> **Tip**
> Whichever you start from, 7x and the Exponential Foundation strongly encourage you to submit the result by pull
> request to the package server repository: [Contribute your site package](../contribute-your-site-package.md).
> [Forking a site package](../your-own/forking-a-site-package.md) explains the first steps.
